trust_decision.summary: The HMAC-SHA256 request-signature check (computed v0= hash constant-time compared with the x-slack-signature header) runs in SlackEventSignatureVerifier::verify_at_time. On mismatch it builds an error that carries both the full received and the full expected signature, and the default listener error handler logs that error with {:?}.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'verifier errors disclose valid HMACs', so the engineer opens the WrongSignatureError Display impl that prints 'received hash' and 'generated hash'.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API SlackEventSignatureVerifier::verify (src/signature_verifier.rs:30), reached by HyperExtensions::decode_signed_response (src/hyper_tokio/hyper_ext.rs:98-128) from the hyper push/command/interaction listeners and the axum events_layer middleware
public error struct SlackEventWrongSignatureError with pub fields and a derived Debug and Builder; reached through the same verify() error path
Display of SlackEventWrongSignatureError, also reached through Display of SlackEventSignatureVerifierError (src/signature_verifier.rs:128-139)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All four HTTP entry points (src/hyper_tokio/listener/push_events.rs:48, src/hyper_tokio/listener/command_events.rs:52, src/hyper_tokio/listener/interaction_events.rs:34-43, src/axum_support/slack_events_middleware.rs:88) share one sink: decode_signed_response -> verify -> the one error struct. No second HMAC implementation exists (Hmac is used only at src/signature_verifier.rs:74).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The only arguable leftover is the derived Debug (src/signature_verifier.rs:182). A solver who fixes only Display can argue that Debug is a developer-only representation, but the default handler logs {:?} (src/listener.rs:52), so that argument fails.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Signature verification must still accept correctly signed requests and still return a WrongSignatureError variant with body_len and ts for diagnostics. The published fix also keeps an 11-char received-hash prefix. An over-broad fix that suppresses the error or changes the variant breaks the existing tests.

O6_input_shapes: Display and Debug of the wrapping SlackEventSignatureVerifierError enum
both secrets: the expected (generated) hash, and the full received hash (valid when the local secret is misconfigured)

O7_producer.where: The error is produced inline in the handler path at src/signature_verifier.rs:51-59; there is no serializer, schema or cache (the struct derives no Serialize, src/signature_verifier.rs:182).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a debug!/trace! log of the received x-slack-signature header value before verification
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Maintainers already log request URIs at debug level around verification (src/axum_support/slack_events_middleware.rs:85,135), so logging the header for troubleshooting is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a timestamp-error message that echoes the received or computed hash alongside ts
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The timestamp error is built just after the hash compare succeeds and already formats diagnostic context; adding the hash for correlation is a natural diagnostic choice.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second axum-side wrapper error that copies received/expected signatures into its own fields before calling error_handler
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The axum middleware is a separate transport wrapper over the hyper helper; a planted wrapper error at distance would match the 'second implementation' lever.

O9_family: CWE-532 sensitive information in log files (secret-derived HMAC in error Display/Debug)

O10_build.toolchain: cargo (edition 2021); the verifier sits behind the 'signature-verifier' feature (Cargo.toml:25)
O10_build.project_tests: Unit tests in src/signature_verifier.rs:223-316 (success, precoded vector, empty secret, wrong signature, ts expiry); listener tests in src/hyper_tokio/listener/interaction_events.rs (around lines 190-215).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Remove generated_hash from the Display string only, leaving the field (and the derived Debug) and the full received_hash in place.

out_of_scope_notes: Other secret newtypes already redact Debug (SlackApiTokenValue src/token.rs:11-14, SlackSigningSecret src/models/common/mod.rs:212-216); SlackApiToken.cookie Debug not checked.
Push URL-verification challenge is logged at debug level (src/hyper_tokio/listener/push_events.rs:59-62); it is not a credential for this protection.
